description:
Use this when the user asks which Indian companies recently announced a given kind of disclosure, for example order wins or fundraises, across the whole market.

Returns BSE filings of one kind across all companies, newest first, each with the company, headline, filing time, a link to the PDF and a `news_id`. `bucket` is one of: order-receipts, fundraise, credit-rating, acquisitions, management-changes. `days` is 1 to 90 (default 7). To read a filing, pass its `news_id` and that row's `nse_symbol` or `isin` to get_filing_extract. A long list is cut to fit, with `truncated` set. Listing may queue a few of the filings for reading, which counts against the daily filing allowance. For one company's filings use get_stock_events.
name: get_announcement_bucket
title: Companies by announcement type
